key_insight: A frozen medical LLM/VLM can keep improving after deployment by learning from past cases through external skill, text memory, and visual memory—without retraining model weights.
clinical_relevance: This could help medical AI stay aligned with evolving evidence and workflow needs while preserving the original model and adapting across different clinical tasks.
method: Adds a Skill module for reasoning and tool-use guidance
Stores trustworthy case-based facts in a Knowledge Memory
Uses a Multimodal Knowledge Base to retain and retrieve visual examples, with updates accepted only if they improve new cases without hurting prior ones
evidence_signal: The approach was evaluated online across six benchmarks, four base models, and reported up to a 34.2% improvement over the base model on medical tasks.
watch_item: Because updates depend on external memories and online validation, careful curation and monitoring are needed to avoid propagating incorrect or biased case knowledge.
paper_title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
